create_shardedtensor_from_list: create a ShardedTensor from a list of numpy arrays using the from_list static method
create_shardedtensor_from_data: create a ShardedTensor by passing a data array and starts indices to the constructor
get_shardedtensor_item: get a specific shard from a ShardedTensor by indexing it with an integer
save_shardedtensor: save a ShardedTensor to disk as separate numpy files for starts and data
load_shardedtensor: load a ShardedTensor from disk using the load static method with optional mmap_mode
